visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of short cross-sell pointers, each a small icon beside a sentence with an inline link
visualCharacteristics.layout: Items in a row on desktop (auto-fit grid), stacked below 900px; each item is a small icon to the LEFT of short copy. No card chrome
visualCharacteristics.notes: Band color and centered intro heading come from the section (e.g. pale-grey, centered style) and default content above the block.

contentPattern.structure: one row per item: media cell (:icon: or small image) + body cell (paragraph with inline link)
rows: [Checking accounts] that help keep up with your life.
A [savings account] that can help you reach your goals.
Find the right [credit card] that suits your needs.

usage.description: Related-product pointers (checking, savings, credit card) at the end of deposit promo pages.

reuseGuidance: Use when each item is a small icon to the left of one or two lines of linked copy. For media above centered copy use cards-tile; for a vertical numbered list use cards-steps.
